title: Boom 3D Windows: Experience 3D surround sound in games
description:
Boom 3D: Hear Every Detail. Play with an Advantage.

Whether you are tracking enemy footsteps, exploring vast open worlds, or immersing yourself in cinematic adventures, Boom 3D transforms the way your games sound. Experience powerful system-wide 3D surround sound, precision tuned Headphone EQ, advanced equalizers, and immersive audio effects that work with any game, any media player, and any streaming service.

Designed for gamers and audiophiles alike, Boom 3D enhances every sound with greater depth, clarity, and direction, helping you react faster and experience every moment the way it was meant to be heard.

Gain the Audio Edge

Hear subtle footsteps, distant gunfire, environmental cues, and in-game effects with greater precision. Boom 3D's immersive virtual surround sound delivers a wider, more realistic soundstage on virtually any pair of headphones.

Customize your audio with professional-grade tools and presets built for every game and genre.

Features

• 🎮 Immersive 3D Surround Sound 

• 🎧 Headphone EQ with support for thousands of headphone models 

• 🔊 Powerful System-Wide Audio Enhancer 

• 🎚️ Professional 10-Band & 31-Band Equalizer 

• ✨ Advanced Audio Effects including Spatial Stereo, Fidelity, Night Mode, Ambience & Pitch 

• 🎵 Built-in Audio Player 

• 📻 Access to 20,000+ Radio Stations 

• 🎛️ Apps Volume Controller (Volume Mixer) for individual app audio control 

Upgrade your audio. Hear more. React faster. Experience every game like never before.
description_short: Experience 3D surround that is specifically designed for games on your Windows 10 and 11 devices across any headphones or speakers. Boom 3D's system-wide integration on Windows OS enriches the audio output for every user-interaction making gaming an unbelievably immersive experience.
